audit.name: Words Over Time performance and mobile DOM after measurement
audit.status_reason: The final production build, npm run verify, 36-row browser matrix and Forever keyboard/table interaction passed their recorded checks. Status remains partial because Lighthouse-compatible lab timing did not run and /words/forever reproducibly logs React minified hydration error #418 in a fresh production tab.

payload.html_and_rsc: Raw prerendered files on disk; not compressed network transfer sizes.
payload.initial_js: Sum of unique JavaScript files referenced by prerendered route HTML, including shared Next.js runtime; not route-exclusive and not compressed transfer size.
payload.initial_js_requests: Count of unique JavaScript URLs referenced by prerendered route HTML, not total network request count.
payload.css: One raw referenced CSS artifact of 79256 bytes on every measured route; not a compressed network transfer size.
payload.serialized_props: Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(value)) estimates for the explicit values constructed by route code; estimates are reported separately from raw RSC bytes.

browser.browser: Codex in-app browser against a local Next.js production server
browser.scope_limit: The 36 screenshots record initial render before the final keyboard-only source change. The final production build independently passed the Forever hash, slider keyboard, table, caption and containment interaction check. Browser error-overlay absence is not treated as proof of hydration success because the fresh Forever console reproducibly logs React minified error #418.

laboratory_metrics.null_policy: LCP, CLS, TBT, Speed Index, total request count, transferred bytes, image bytes, long-task totals and lab accessibility scores are null because no valid Lighthouse run completed. Zero is not substituted for an unavailable measurement.

command_evidence.observations: The source TypeScript check passed and was repeated successfully inside the final npm run verify execution.

Final verification build EO9j2G4AzAu8Xfjy287UM compiled in approximately 4.5 minutes; Next's internal TypeScript phase took approximately 18.0 minutes, page-data collection 30.9 seconds, and static generation completed 31/31 pages in 83 seconds. The build discovered the unrelated user-owned untracked /words/privacy/mobile-demo route.

The 36 required initial-render PNGs and 36-row DOM audit came from the immediately preceding successful build. The final server for EO9j2G4AzAu8Xfjy287UM supplied the separate Forever hash/keyboard/table interaction and fresh-tab console evidence. A null exit code means the server was intentionally still running during capture, not that startup failed.
Typecheck, data validation and production build passed. Data validation reported 46 terms, 27 sources, 29 evidence records, 37 relations and 0 warnings.

forever_payload_detail.boundary: The serialized values are JSON byte estimates and are not compressed transfer sizes. The raw RSC comparison above is the artifact-level result. Research source files and values were not modified to obtain the reduction.

client_bundle_findings.method: Initial HTML asset lists were scanned for chunks containing Three.js signatures such as WebGLRenderer, REVISION=, and three.module.
client_bundle_findings.interpretation: The Forever deferral succeeded for its initial asset list; Artificial and Hub remain follow-up performance work. This is a bundle-membership finding, not a Lighthouse timing result.

forever_frequency.interpretation: The mobile reader replaced the orientation refusal. The table is progressively disclosed, so the initial-render audit counts zero tables; the final interaction check opened and verified the table separately.

forever_interaction_at_390px.table_caption: Every plotted yearly Google Books Ngram value for forever, 1700 to 2022

console.diagnostic_limit: A temporary Turbopack dev run failed because node_modules is symlinked outside the project root. A webpack dev run compiled the route too slowly and was aborted before a full component-level mismatch could be isolated.

final_after_browser_audit.screenshot_boundary: The required 36 PNGs precede the last keyboard-only source change; the final keyboard interaction was exercised against build EO9j2G4AzAu8Xfjy287UM.

target_assessment.target: no initial-JS regression on any audited route
target_assessment.reason: Home, Words, About, Privacy, Artificial, Hub and Data increased by 147 to 2278 raw referenced JS bytes; Depression decreased by 160 bytes and Forever decreased by 560499 bytes.

target_assessment.target: meaningful Forever initial client JS or serialized-data reduction
target_assessment.reason: Forever raw referenced initial JS fell 560499 bytes (41.927%), raw RSC fell 608556 bytes (55.077%), and estimated constructed client JSON fell 629177 bytes (57.988%).

target_assessment.target: Three.js absent from unrelated initial route bundles
target_assessment.reason: Forever and Home initial asset lists contain no scanned Three.js signature. Artificial and Hub, which retain Three.js visuals, still reference signature chunks and remain route-specific optimization work.

A fresh /words tab logged no messages, but a fresh /words/forever production tab reproducibly logged one React minified hydration error #418. Error-overlay absence in the screenshot matrix does not override console evidence.
Home, Words, Forever, Privacy, Artificial and Hub had body/root width equal to their viewport at 320, 360, 390 and 430px; the 768 and 1440 rows also reported no horizontal overflow.
Exit code 0; typecheck, data validation and final production build succeeded with 0 data warnings.

verified_wins: Forever raw HTML, RSC, initial JS and constructed client JSON are materially smaller in the measured production artifact.
Forever no longer exposes its wider-screen refusal in the captured viewport matrix and presents a mobile reader from 320 through 768px.
All 36 browser-audit rows show no horizontal overflow, one H1, one main landmark, no duplicate IDs, no unnamed visible buttons, no visible error overlay and no wider-screen fallback.

The final Forever interaction preserved #spelling-frequency, moved the 2022 slider to 2021 with ArrowLeft, opened a 323-row yearly table with the expected caption, and retained 390px body containment.
npm run verify passed on source HEAD 4d777597487062c23c9a75f65470ac6e7760abe1.
verified_misses_or_open_items: The strict no-initial-JS-regression target was not met on seven routes, although increases were small in raw byte terms.
Artificial and Hub still include Three.js in their initial asset lists.
LCP, CLS, TBT and Speed Index remain unknown.
Forever reproducibly logs React minified hydration error #418 in a fresh production tab; this is a P1 defect even though interaction checks pass and no error overlay is visible.
Artificial still has 11 visible controls below the approximately 44px audit threshold at 320px.
Full reduced-motion, screen-reader and 200% text-zoom regression checks remain follow-up manual QA.
release_interpretation.claim_boundary: These measurements establish payload and implementation changes. They do not establish ranking, traffic, CTR, Core Web Vitals or user-behavior improvement.
